Dr. Tyler Bigenho, D.C. | CEO & Founder of CleanSpine | Indonesian-American Chiropractor in Irvine, CA

Irvine Chiropractor Dr. Tyler Bigenho, D.C. (CleanSpine CEO) welcomes you!  My channel is dedicated to showcasing chiropractic care in an educational and relatable way. Watch informative videos featuring full-body chiropractic adjustments, Y-Strap spinal decompression, and inspiring real patient stories showcasing relief from back pain, neck pain, and improved mobility. We do not claim to cure or treat specific conditions. Our focus is on helping people find relief, understand their bodies better, restore movement, and feel their best.

📍 Providing expert chiropractic care in Irvine, CA | Sharing insights and filming patient stories globally
📧 Business inquiries: drtyler@cleanspine.com
⭐️Collabs: drtylercollabs@gmail.com
